interpretation: All31 source allegations are dispositioned, not inherited as proven defects. Current whole-file identities plus symbols and observations govern reuse. Physical causation, efficacy and performance remain untested. Inventory completion does not complete repair tasks.

defects.title: prior_screen_dependency
defects.observed_behavior: An unchanged program receives different pressure results when only caller-supplied descriptors change (30000 to 36000 Pa in the synthetic probe). This is a prior screen, not an independent physical evaluator.

independent_regression.negative_fixture: Hold physical program fixed; change hydraulic_resistance_factor only and demand evaluator invariance.
independent_regression.positive_control: Same program and same descriptors reproduce the same metric.
independent_regression.status: minimal_software_behavior_reproduced; full repair regression remains with primary task

defects.title: reference_flow_configuration

independent_regression.negative_fixture: Generate dictionaries for the same frozen subject with challenged schemes/layers/startup and independently compare admitted vortex observables; no physical run in this packet.
independent_regression.positive_control: Fresh-case generator succeeds; overwrite attempt rejects.
independent_regression.status: minimal_software_behavior_reproduced; full repair regression remains with primary task

independent_regression.positive_control: Same stricter threshold under the consumed legacy key rejects, isolating key selection.
